title: 第四十九章 施主用力些第四十九章 施主用力些
slug: 镇守魔门圣女我每天暴涨一年功力
lines: 和尚大骇。
“怎么可能？你居然没事？”
“包的啊牢底。”江澜有琉璃净息术。
事实上，他早就察觉到，和尚撒出的粉末大概率不对劲了。
一个玩香的，想想也知道，撒出来的不可能只是单纯的石灰那么简单。
原本，他身上接触到香粉的位置，还有点轻微的麻木。
可随着他运转琉璃静息术，胸口处顿时一股清凉的气息散开，很快便将那点麻木感给压了下去。
活动了下脖子，江澜深吸一口气道：
“别说，还挺提神。”
和尚面色再变。
他几乎没有任何犹豫，转身便朝着马车后方退去。
江澜脚下一动。
下一瞬，他整个人便已经出现在和尚面前。
“这么急着走做什么？不再聊聊了？”
和尚眸中凶光一闪，紧接着，一柄薄如蝉翼的柳叶刀，便出现在他掌心之中。
他猛地一个转身，柳叶刀直刺江澜心口。
不过这和尚，大概也就八品锻骨的实力，在江澜面前，还是差了太多。
江澜直接抬手一抓，直接便扣住和尚手腕。
“咔嚓！”
熟悉的脆响声响起。
“啊哈~”
和尚叫唤一声，短刃脱手落地。
“你特么让猪配了啊，叫的那么烧？”
和尚却是再没了战意，转身就想往后跑。
可是江澜哪儿还会给他跑路的机会，直接伸手一把掐住和尚脖子，将他整个人按在马车上。
车身一震。
江澜看着面前的和尚。
“姓甚名谁，家里几口，老娘多大？”
小和尚面色涨红，眼里满是惊恐，却还是死死咬着牙，一言不发。
“诶我……你还挺硬？”
说着，他直接伸出手，扣住和尚右手手腕。
“嘎巴！”
“哈啊~”
这会不会有点太隐晦了？
那和尚满脸怨毒地看着江澜，有些艰难地娇声道：“你敢动我，主人不会放过你的。”
“啊？”江澜一双大大的眼睛里，满是疑惑，“我知道古代玩的花，但你们当和尚的，也玩的这么花吗？还有小圈文化？”
和尚当然听不懂江澜在说什么，只是依旧涨红着脸。
至于为什么涨红……
content_en:
The monk was horrified.
"How is that possible? Are you okay?"
"It's guaranteed." Jiang Lan has the glass breath purification technique.
In fact, he had already noticed that there was probably something wrong with the powder the monk spread.
As a person who plays with incense, if he thinks about it, he knows that what is scattered cannot be as simple as pure lime.
Originally, the parts of his body that came into contact with the scented powder were still slightly numb.
But as he used the Liuli Resting Technique, a cool breath suddenly spread out from his chest, quickly suppressing the numbness.
After moving his neck, Jiang Lan took a deep breath and said:
"Don't tell me, it's quite refreshing."
The monk's expression changed again.
Without any hesitation, he turned around and retreated towards the back of the carriage.
Jiang Lan moved his feet.
The next moment, he appeared in front of the monk.
"Why are you leaving in such a hurry? No more chatting?"
A fierce light flashed in the monk's eyes, and then, a lancet as thin as a cicada's wing appeared in his palm.
He turned around suddenly, and the lancet pierced Jiang Lan's heart.
However, this monk's strength was probably only at the eighth level of bone forging, but he was still far behind in front of Jiang Lan.
Jiang Lan raised his hand and grabbed the monk's wrist.
"Crack!"
A familiar crisp sound sounded.
"Aha~"
The monk shouted, and the short blade fell to the ground.
Jiang Lan: "?"
"Why on earth did you let a pig mate and howl like that?"
The monk no longer had the will to fight, turned around and wanted to run back.
But Jiang Lan wouldn't give him a chance to run away. He stretched out his hand and grabbed the monk's neck and pinned him down on the carriage.
"Bang!"
The car body shook.
Jiang Lan looked at the monk in front of him.
"What's your last name? How many people are in your family? How old am I?"
The little monk's face turned red and his eyes were full of fear, but he still gritted his teeth and said nothing.
"Hey, I...are you still pretty hard?"
As he spoke, he stretched out his hand and clasped the monk's right wrist.
"Gaba!"
"Haa~"
Jiang Lan: "?"
Isn't this a bit too cryptic?
The monk looked at Jiang Lan with a face full of resentment, and said softly with some difficulty: "If you dare to touch me, the master will not let you go."
"Ah?" Jiang Lan's big eyes were full of doubts, "I know about the entertainment in ancient times, but you monks, do you also have such entertainment? Do you still have a small circle culture?"
Of course the monk didn't understand what Jiang Lan was saying, but he still blushed.
As for why it turned red...
